source_research.title: On the Performance of Lagged Momentum and Reversal Strategies Across Daytime and Overnight Sessions in Bitcoin and Ethereum Cryptocurrencies
source_research.venue: Journal of Risk and Financial Management
source_research.source_selection_warning: The paper searches many cutoff/strategy combinations in-sample, then reports a 2021-2025 holdout. We do not import either result as our evidence and do not repeat the search. The paper was published on 2026-09-06, after every 2026H1 observation in our frozen Stage-1 window; therefore 2026H1 is a retrospective post-source-sample replication that was unread by this project at predeclaration, not a prospective/live or publication-blind holdout.
source_research.extracted_mechanism: A fixed UTC day/night decomposition may expose persistent intraday return structure. The source's frozen ETH 05:00-17:00 UTC daytime / 17:00-05:00 UTC nighttime specification combines a constant-long nighttime leg with daytime reversal based only on the prior completed daytime-session return.

scientific_hypothesis.economic_mechanism: If crypto liquidity/risk transfer has persistent UTC time-of-day structure, the sign of the prior completed ETH daytime session may be negatively autocorrelated with the next 05:00-17:00 UTC daytime session while the complementary 17:00-05:00 UTC session retains positive drift.
scientific_hypothesis.falsifiable_claim: Without tuning the 05:00 UTC cutoff or the Long/Reversal rule, the source-frozen ETH strategy has positive after-screening-cost expectancy in the frozen retrospective post-source-sample 2026H1 replication, beats exposure-matched simple baselines, and is not explained by one validation subperiod or a single extreme day. Passing this screen is replication evidence only and cannot be called genuine-forward evidence.

data_contract.source: Kraken official downloadable historical OHLCVT incremental archives
data_contract.instrument: ETH/USD spot pair as named by the frozen Kraken archive manifest
required_archive_receipts: MANIFEST.json bytes and sha256 from each archive
data_contract.pair_resolution_rule: Resolve the exact ETH/USD file from the Kraken archive manifest/preflight. Do not silently substitute ETH/USDT, futures, another exchange, or a guessed filename.
data_contract.missing_hour_policy: Any trading date lacking one of the required hourly close observations for the previous/current day or night session is DATA/PIT_INCONCLUSIVE for that date; no interpolation or forward fill.
data_contract.incremental_archive_reason: Q1+Q2 2026 are sufficient. Include the 2026-01-01 04:00 UTC hourly row as the one-bar pre-window close context required by the pinned source code's close.pct_change() before the 05:00 day-session return; 2026-01-01 05:00-17:00 is warmup only. The first scored trading date is 2026-01-02, whose night is 2026-01-01 17:00-2026-01-02 05:00 and whose daytime position uses the sign of the completed 2026-01-01 daytime return.
data_contract.genuine_forward_boundary_reason: The predeclaration formed at 2026-09-24T01:00:00Z during the 2026-09-24 trading date's 17:00-05:00 night session. To prevent partial pre-formation exposure from entering a full trading-date unit, genuine-forward authority starts at the next 17:00 UTC night-entry boundary; 2026-09-25 is the first complete night+day trading date wholly formed after predeclaration.
data_contract.warmup_context_authority: The 2026-01-01 04:00 UTC row is context-only for the first 05:00 close-to-close return and may not be scored as a session or used to tune the rule.

signal_rules.session_return: compound the 12 hourly close-to-close bar returns in the exact session; require all 12 bars
signal_rules.day_position: negative sign of the immediately previous completed 05:00-17:00 UTC daytime-session return
signal_rules.first_replication_day_day_position: 2026-01-01 05:00-17:00 UTC daytime-session return is warmup only; the first scored trading date is 2026-01-02, whose daytime position uses the sign of that completed 2026-01-01 daytime return

execution_rules.day_entry: 05:00 UTC boundary after prior daytime-session return is already completed
execution_rules.trade_price_semantics: use the first executable hourly boundary price represented by the Kraken hourly archive after confirming archive timestamp semantics in deterministic preflight; if the archive cannot support exact boundary execution without look-ahead, classify DATA/PIT_INCONCLUSIVE and do not proxy with future close

cost_model.turnover_definition: absolute change in signed position at each session boundary; long-to-short or short-to-long flip has turnover 2
cost_model.survivor_requirement: Before any profitability or deep-validation claim, replace screen-only costs with trustworthy PIT Kraken fee/spread/slippage evidence and, for short exposure, authenticated margin/borrow/funding implementability and cost evidence.

multiple_testing.future_sibling_rule: Any future sibling must be newly frozen before its outcomes and remains in the same multiplicity family; it cannot reset rejected/exact/semantic memory.

cheap_stage_gates.single_day_dependence_rule: Remove the single best UTC trading date; remaining after-cost cumulative arithmetic PnL must stay positive.
cheap_stage_gates.underpowered_action: classify UNDERPOWERED/DATA_INCONCLUSIVE; do not change cutoff, session length, rule, retrospective-holdout boundary, or genuine-forward boundary

baseline_and_ablation_plan.baseline_1_always_long: On identical 05:00/17:00 boundaries, remain long ETH in both day and night sessions with identical turnover/cost accounting.
baseline_and_ablation_plan.baseline_2_night_only: Long only the 17:00-05:00 UTC night session and hold cash in the 05:00-17:00 daytime session.
baseline_and_ablation_plan.baseline_3_day_always_long: Long only the 05:00-17:00 UTC daytime session and hold cash overnight.
baseline_and_ablation_plan.primary_ablation: Keep the night LONG leg but replace daytime reversal with CASH; tests whether the reversal component adds incremental economic value beyond night drift.
baseline_and_ablation_plan.sign_flip_falsifier: Keep night LONG but use daytime MOMENTUM, i.e. positive sign of the previous completed daytime-session return.
baseline_and_ablation_plan.one_session_delay: Keep night LONG; set each daytime position to negative sign of the daytime-session return from two trading dates earlier rather than one; no retuning.
baseline_and_ablation_plan.complexity_rule: The combined strategy does not survive as a mechanism if it fails to add after-cost value over night-only in the full replication and both halves, even if total PnL is positive.
baseline_and_ablation_plan.randomized_timing_and_volatility_match: Required only for a legitimate Stage-1 survivor under #517; exact controls must be frozen and independently reviewed before those survivor outcomes are used for Stage 2.

successive_halving.stage_1: one strict 2026-01-02 through 2026-06-30 retrospective post-source-sample screen, frozen before this project reads those outcomes, with the fixed 05:00 UTC Long/Reversal rule and screen-only 24/48/72 bps costs
successive_halving.stage_2: only if Stage 1 survives: run already-frozen/simple baselines and then independently frozen #517 randomized-timing/volatility-matched controls plus authenticated execution-cost and short-implementability evidence
successive_halving.stage_3: at most one global Strategy Factory deep candidate may advance; no publication-derived promotion priority; genuine-forward evidence begins only at the frozen post-formation boundary

experiment_value.priority_reason: A simple materially distinct mechanism with public code and a frozen, unread-by-project 2026H1 post-source-sample retrospective window can cheaply test temporal extension under much harsher after-cost screening; only post-formation observations at the frozen genuine-forward boundary can later support genuine-forward claims.

exact_next_action: Complete #520 hypothesis-driven Kraken 2026Q1+Q2 ETH/USD hourly incremental-archive preflight using the one required 2026-01-01 04:00 UTC context row and the frozen warmup/scored window, without reading 2026-07-01 onward. Bind exact archive/MANIFEST/normalized-row identities into a new execution contract, pass canonical semantic/exact rejected-memory admission, exact-head CI and independent review, then run the frozen retrospective 2026H1 v1 exactly once. Do not tune from the result and do not call it genuine-forward evidence. Preserve the separately frozen post-formation genuine-forward boundary.
